candidates.name: INSPIRE Index Polygons spatial data
verified_facts: The guidance describes INSPIRE Index Polygons as open spatial data showing indicative locations of registered freehold property.
The data is supplied in GML for geographic systems and is not a substitute for an individual title plan.
Current access is directed to HM Land Registry's Use land and property data service.
semantic_limits: This guidance establishes product scope and service handoff only; publication freshness is taken from the current dataset service and geometry is not treated as exact title extent or elevation.

candidates.name: National Polygon Service
verified_facts: The National Polygon Service groups National Polygon, Title Number and UPRN Look Up, and Title Descriptor products.
National Polygon information provides indicative shape and position for registered-title indexing.
Title Descriptor supplies registration attributes such as estate interest and class of title rather than survey measurements.
semantic_limits: The guidance is used only for product hierarchy and meaning; no licensed or chargeable records were acquired, and none of these products alone supplies parcel terrain elevation or exact determined-boundary coordinates.
